feature_name: Sitemap-based indexing and refresh for Vertex AI Search web pages
summary: Adds support for indexing and refreshing web pages in an advanced-indexing-enabled data store by submitting XML sitemaps or sitemap indexes through the API.
extended_definition: Adds support for indexing and refreshing web pages in an advanced-indexing-enabled data store by submitting XML sitemaps or sitemap indexes through the API.
